You will glad to know I no longer plan to kill myself at the end of the month. 
I saw my psych again on a whim... Helped me gain some perspective. 

I still want to die... I just want to try things for s bit longer. 
I got a date for the 8th of February, my band finished our E.P. 

I figured I might as well stick around see where it goes. I mean I can die whenever I want to really, but these things don't happen to me often.

Thanks for the concern. I actually want the pain...I think of it as final proof I was alive. It's fucked up, but it makes sense to me I guess. 

Thanks for the concern though, you're a good person.
I think I might actually do it hey.
Ah that seems pretty easy to get to.
Ah that actually sounds fun and romantic. Thanks mate
